debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-m-u-l-a-t-e-d a s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e f-o-r r-o-t-a-t-i-n-g w-i-n-b-i-d-s a-m-o-n-g c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e t-a-k-i-n-g s-h-o-w-i-n-g t-h-e r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t o-f-i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a w-i-t-h r-i-v-a-l-s v-i-a e-n-c-r-y-p-t-e-d c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s a-n-d l-e-f-t m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a l-o-g-s o-f the t-r-a-n-s-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
3) the a-c-t-o-r s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-d-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-i-t-h p-r-e-a-g-r-e-e-d d-e-s-c-o-n-n-e-c-t-i-o-n-s a-n-d l-e-f-t d-r-a-f-t-s h-i-d-d-e-n i-n an u-n-l-a-b-e-l-e-d f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-g-r-e-e-d o-n o-f-f-b-o-o-k c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n t-e-r-m-s f-o-r a-l-l p-a-r-t-i-c-i-p-a-t-i-n-g p-a-r-t-i-e-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a c-r-y-p-t-e-d a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t i-n an i-n-s-e-c-u-r-e l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-i-n-i-m-i-z-e-d t-r-a-c-e-a-b-i-l-i-t-y o-f the c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d e-f-f-o-r-t-s u-s-i-n-g e-f-f-e-m-e-r-a-l c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-o-o-l-s a-n-d l-e-f-t d-e-v-i-c-e l-o-g-s o-f the s-h-o-r-t-l-i-v-e-d c-h-a-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c i-m-a-g-e o-f the d-e-v-i-c-e-s
